item.title: Lebanon Cabinet Orders End to Hezbollah Armed Activities | Beirut Today - Beirut Today
item.description: Lebanon’s Cabinet has formally declared that no armed or security activity can take place on Lebanese territory outside the authority of the state. Prime Minister Nawaf Salam announced the move following a Cabinet session at Baabda Palace, describing recent rocket launches claimed by Hezbollah as a breach of constitutional principles and the government’s stated policy. item.description: Lebanon’s National Council for Scientific Research (CNRS), in collaboration with the Disaster Risk Management Unit (DRM) at the Prime Minister’s Office, has launched a new digital platform aimed at providing up-to-date information about the situation in the country. item.title: Parliament Approves Two-Year Extension - Beirut Today
item.description: Today, the Lebanese parliament voted to approve a two-year extension of its current mandate. The vote concluded this morning with 76 votes in favor, 41 against, and four abstentions. Parliamentary elections were originally scheduled for May of this year. item.title: Displacement Across Lebanon | Beirut Today - Beirut Today
item.description: As displacement rises across Lebanon due to the ongoing war, grassroots initiatives are working to support families forced to leave their homes. The Amal Initiative, founded by a group of volunteers from different backgrounds, is helping provide essential supplies to displaced families. With rising prices and limited funding, the needs remain far greater than the resources available. item.title: March 10th, Latest Situation in Lebanon | Beirut Today - Beirut Today
item.description: Lebanon’s Disaster Risk Management Unit released its latest Daily Situation Report, on March 10th, 2026, highlighting the growing humanitarian toll of the war. According to the report, 759,300 people are currently displaced across the country, with 122,600 individuals sheltering in 580 collective shelters. item.description: In addition to the ongoing and expanding Israeli attacks across the country, Lebanon is also facing the dual impact of its prolonged socioeconomic crisis and fluctuations in international energy markets. item.description: Displaced families fleeing bombardment in South Lebanon have found refuge at the Lebanese National Theatre in Tripoli. item.description: Today, an Israeli airstrike on the city of Nabatieh killed one Lebanese Army solider, injured four others, one of whom is in critical condition. The strike occurred as they were traveling through the city in a car and on a motorcycle, according to a statement by the Lebanese Army’s official page on X.
